### Jesus’ Prayer and Plan for Your Failures
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-april-22-2022.html
Passage: Luke 22:31-32
Points:
- Jesus is never caught off guard by our failures, but foresees them completely before they happen.
- Even before we stumble, Christ is already interceding in prayer for our faith to endure.
- Jesus speaks with confidence that restoration will follow repentance, saying "when" rather than "if."
- God intends for us to use the lessons learned from our failures to encourage and strengthen others.

### Three Ways to Stay Faithful in a Sifting Season
Author: Meredith Houston Carr
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-august-11-2020.html
Passage: Luke 22:31-32
Points:
- Painful seasons of sifting serve a divine purpose to remove the worthless chaff from our hearts.
- Believers should not panic when shaken, because trials are an expected part of spiritual refinement.
- Staying anchored in a praying community is essential for surviving intense testing.
- Remembering God's redemptive purpose brings peace, knowing He equips tested believers to help others.
